sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.

1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the material brought on record.
2.

The present second bail application has been filed by the applicant in Special Session Trial No.
1095 of 2022 (State vs. Sunil), arising out of Case Crime No. 26 of 2022, under Sections - 376-D,
506 I.P.C., 5G/6 of POCSO Act, Police Station - Basai Araila, District - Agra, with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.

entities.text:
Special Session Trial No.
1095 of 2022 (State vs. Sunil
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The first bail application of applicant was rejected by this Court, vide order dated 09.05.2023.
3.
It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant-accused is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in this case.

According to prosecution version, on 20.05.2022 at 8:00 Sunil vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/4759021/
1 PM while the daughter of informant has gone to ranch for attending the call of nature, applicant and co-accused Chhaviram caught her and committed rape upon her.

entities.text: Sunil vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel submitted that the age of victim has been shown 13 years but in her medical examination report, there is no external or internal injury on the body of victim and no definite opinion has been given regarding sexual assault.
The medical examination of the victim was conducted soon after the incident without any undue delay.
Medical examination report of the victim falsifies the prosecution version.
Learned counsel has referred statements of victim, recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C., and submitted that the allegations of rape levelled against the applicant are thoroughly false.

4. It is further submitted that first bail application of applicant was rejected by this Court vide order dated 09.05.2023 and after that statement of informant as well as of victim have been recorded before the trial court, wherein they did not support the prosecution version and turned hostile.

Learned counsel has referred statement of victim/P.W.-1, wherein she has stated that applicant and co-accused Chhaviram have not committed any incident with her and she has denied involvement of the applicant in any such incident.
It was submitted that there are number of formal witnesses, who are yet to be examined, and trial of the case would take sufficient long time.

Lastly, it was submitted that applicant is languishing in jail since 22.05.2022 and that in case, applicant is enlarged on bail,
he will not misuse the liberty of bail.
5. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail.

6. Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, facts of the case, nature of allegations, period of custody and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, a case for bail is made out.
Hence, the present second bail application is hereby allowed.

7. Let the applicant - Sunil involved in the aforesaid crime be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two local sureties each of the like amount to the satisfaction of court concerned subject to the following conditions:
i. The applicant will not tamper with the evidence during trial.
ii.
The applicant will not pressurize/intimidate the prosecution witnesses.
iii. The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
iv. The applicant will not try to contact, threat or otherwise influence the complainant or any of the witness of the case.
8. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the trial court shall be at liberty to cancel the bail of applicant in accordance with law.

Order Date :- 15.4.2024 S Rawat  Sunil vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/4759021/
